question: What is the name of the submarine commissioned by India on January 15, 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**INS Vagsheer**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Indian Navy** officially commissioned **INS Vagsheer** on **January 15, 2025**. This submarine represents the **sixth** and final vessel of the **Project-75** (P-75) **Kalvari-class**.
 
• The commissioning ceremony took place at the **Naval Dockyard** in **Mumbai**, marking a significant milestone in India's naval capabilities and domestic shipbuilding.
 
• **INS Vagsheer** was built by **Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited (MDL)** in **Mumbai**, in technical collaboration with the **Naval Group** of **France**.
 
• The submarine is designed to operate in various naval theaters, capable of performing diverse missions such as **anti-surface warfare**, **anti-submarine warfare**, **intelligence gathering**, **mine laying**, and **area surveillance**.
 
• The naming of the submarine follows the naval tradition of resurrecting names of illustrious predecessors; it is named after the **Sand Fish**, a deadly deep-sea predator of the **Indian Ocean**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Project-75 and the Kalvari Class:**
 
 
• **Project-75** involved the construction of **six** **Scorpene-class** diesel-electric attack submarines.
 
• The first five submarines of this class already in active service are **INS Kalvari** (commissioned in **2017**), **INS Khanderi** (**2019**), **INS Karanj** (**2021**), **INS Vela** (**2021**), and **INS Vagir** (**2023**).
 
• These submarines are known for their advanced **stealth features**, including superior **acoustic absorption** techniques, low radiated noise levels, and a hydro-dynamically optimized shape.
 
 
 
• **Technical Specifications:**
 
 
• **INS Vagsheer** is equipped with **long-range guided torpedoes** and **tube-launched anti-ship missiles**, providing it with a lethal "punch" to strike targets both on the surface and underwater.
 
• It features the **Submarine Tactical Integrated Combat System (SUBTICS)**, which integrates all sensors and weapon systems for efficient combat management.
 
• The submarine can operate at high speeds and reach significant depths, making it difficult for enemy sensors to detect.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Historical Context:** The original **INS Vagsheer** was a **Vela-class** (Soviet Foxtrot-class) submarine commissioned into the **Indian Navy** on **December 26, 1974**, and was decommissioned on **April 30, 1997**, after two decades of service.
 
• **Atmanirbhar Bharat:** The completion of the **Project-75** series is a major boost to the **"Make in India"** and **"Atmanirbhar Bharat"** (Self-reliant India) initiatives, showcasing India’s prowess in complex underwater engineering.
 
• **Strategic Impact:** With the commissioning of **INS Vagsheer**, the **Indian Navy** enhances its maritime security posture in the **Indian Ocean Region (IOR)**, ensuring better protection of sea lines of communication and deterrent capabilities against regional threats.
 
• **Future Prospects:** Following the completion of **Project-75**, the Indian government is moving forward with **Project-75I**, which aims to build even more advanced submarines with **Air-Independent Propulsion (AIP)** systems to increase underwater endurance.
